author.procedure: single pass, written without consulting the parser source; not edited after freezing

rules: Preserve limb identity: the same arms, legs, hands and head as the original, no added or removed body parts.
Preserve moving/still status of every mentioned body part and the stillness of still captions.
Preserve each amplitude grade (high/low) and speed grade (fast/slow) and which body parts it applies to.
Describe the motion freely in clinically meaningful terms; do not reuse the template phrasing 'with high/low amplitude and fast/slow speed'.
Do not use General Movements Assessment categories (e.g. fidgety, writhing, cramped-synchronised) or any term that adds movement quality beyond amplitude and speed.
Keep ambiguities of the original (e.g. grades whose scope is unclear) rather than resolving them.
